title: Enterprise Security, Privacy & Trust
subtitle: SpotSign AI protects workforce data with secure access controls, enterprise SSO, encryption, and detailed audit logging.
governanceStatement: We believe enterprise trust requires transparency. Rather than displaying unverified third-party badges, we explain the security and governance practices that protect your workforce data.

principles.title: Secure Data Separation
principles.desc: Customer data is separated and access is restricted to authorized users, helping prevent unauthorized access across accounts.

principles.title: Role-Based Access Controls
principles.desc: Pre-configured permission profiles for HR, payroll, finance, operations, IT, and employees, with strict separation of duties.

principles.title: Enterprise SSO & MFA
principles.desc: Connect Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID, and SAML identity providers with mandatory multi-factor authentication.

principles.title: Detailed Audit Logging
principles.desc: Administrative actions such as salary revisions, bank updates, and permission changes are recorded with user, IP address, and timestamp.

principles.title: Encryption in Transit & at Rest
principles.desc: Network communications use TLS 1.3, and stored records and employee documents are encrypted at rest using AES-256.

principles.title: Controlled Data Handling
principles.desc: Customer data is never sold, shared, or used to train external systems.
